correctness.rationale: Independence-set case split gives the factored polynomial. The phase equation at z=iy>0 gives every admissible theta=(4j+3)pi/(2k), and modulus yields each exact r threshold. Q(0)=1; every axis zero is simple since Q_z=r(1-(k-1)z)/(1+z) and horizontal crossing speed equals k*y^2/[r*(1+(k-1)^2*y^2)]>0. At r=0 all roots are -1, the degree is fixed and roots are uniformly bounded on compact r intervals, so no other changes in half-plane root count are possible. Thus the exact N_+ and N_0 formulas follow for all r>0,k>=1. The extracted standard-library verifier independently checked 108748 explicit labelled vertex subsets, 940 exact rational Routh cases, and the exact r=8,k=6 boundary factorization; those finite checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Determines sharp strict and closed half-plane stability for all numbers of clique vertices and all pendant multiplicities, plus the exact number of right-half-plane conjugate pairs across every successive threshold. Nontrivial features include r=8,k=6 boundary roots and the second crossing for k>=8, which qualitative eventual-nonstability results and the known corona polynomial formula do not determine. The object is a natural infinite graph construction directly motivated by recent whiskering and independence-root literature.
